Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_Chance_tooltip: Percentage of double-door fridges with the Dr Pepper look. Default: 100%%.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_WornChance_toolti: Chance for a Dr Pepper fridge to use the worn design. Default: 25%%.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_FillLevel1_toolti: Stored capacity percentage that starts this visual stage. Does not change storage capacity. Thresholds are sorted automatically. Default: 10%%.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_FillLevel2_toolti: Stored capacity percentage that starts this visual stage. Does not change storage capacity. Thresholds are sorted automatically. Default: 20%%.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_FillLevel3_toolti: Stored capacity percentage that starts this visual stage. Does not change storage capacity. Thresholds are sorted automatically. Default: 30%%.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DrinkThirst_toolt: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 9.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DrinkHunger_toolt: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 3.6.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DietDrinkHunger_t: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 0.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DrinkFatigue_tool: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 10.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DrinkStress_toolt: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 20.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DrinkUnhappiness_: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 20.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DrinkBoredom_tool: Reduction in points per full can. Partial drinking gives proportional effects. 0 disables this effect. Default: 0.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_RegularLootMultip: 0 = none; 1 = normal; 10 = tenfold. Only affects newly generated loot in unexplored areas. Default: 1.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_DietLootMultiplie: 0 = none; 1 = normal; 10 = tenfold. Only affects newly generated loot in unexplored areas. Default: 1.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_PostersEnabled_to: Chance per eligible building or outdoor vending location. At most one poster; requires a free wall in a newly generated chunk. Visited buildings are excluded.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_PosterChance_tool: Chance per eligible building or outdoor vending location. At most one poster; requires a free wall in a newly generated chunk. Visited buildings are excluded. Default: 10%%.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_PosterNearDrinksO: Enabled: near drink fridges and soda machines. Disabled: checkout counters also qualify.
Sandbox_DrPepperFridge_PosterRadius_tool: Maximum distance from the appliance or counter. Placement stays in the same new chunk and location. Default: 3.
